meta.title: Mylder: live map of Copenhagen
meta.description: Copenhagen's buses, S-tog, metro and trains on one live map, honest about how fresh each position is.

legend.label: Data states
legend.noLive: No vehicle can be Live: Rejseplanen sends only estimated positions.

pulse.averageDelaySub: min, vehicles with a known delay, Metro left out

unknown.metro: No realtime from the Metro; placed from the timetable
unknown.computed-meters: Every position is computed by Rejseplanen

pulse.budget: Updating every {interval} to stay within the data budget.

states.live: Reported by the vehicle in the latest answers.
states.ageing: Last reported a few minutes ago; moving on along its path since.
states.estimated: Placed from the timetable and a known delay, or computed by Rejseplanen.
states.timetableOnly: No realtime for this trip today; placed from the timetable.
states.noSignal: Had realtime, missing for 5 min; moving on the timetable and its last delay.
